# std/zstd

Zstandard (RFC 8878) in pure Milo. `decompress` is a complete frame decoder (Huffman
and FSE entropy coding, repeat offsets, checksum verification) that round-trips real
`zstd` output byte for byte; `compress` does real LZ77 and FSE compression.

```milo
from "std/zstd" import { Zstd }
```

## Example

```milo
let packed = Zstd.compress("hello, hello, hello, hello")
print(Zstd.decompress(packed)!)   // hello, hello, hello, hello
```
